annotations.title: Set posting times for the workspace

description: Set the posting times every account in the workspace follows unless it has its own. [] clears them, back to suggested times. apply_to_all also clears each account's own times, so every account uses these. Approving a post takes the next free one.

apply_to_all.description: Also clear every account's own times, so all of them use these

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: posting_times_set
title: Set posting times for the workspace
